deep-space.$description: Deep Space — Page background, deepest canvas layer, link-on-light contrast

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Hero and large content surface, slightly lifted from canvas

carbon-teal.$description: Carbon Teal — Card surface, button hover backgrounds, elevated containers

slate-drift.$description: Slate Drift — Subtle borders, dividers, muted panel borders, ghost button surfaces

bone-white.$description: Bone White — Primary text, icon strokes, button text, nav labels

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Secondary text, link default state, muted body

fog-gray.$description: Fog Gray — Tertiary text, nav helper labels, subtle metadata

smoke-gray.$description: Smoke Gray — Muted paragraph text, de-emphasized descriptions

pewter.$description: Pewter — Disabled or low-emphasis body text

mint-signal.$description: Mint Signal — Teal supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

deep-teal.$description: Deep Teal — Muted teal surface for announcement banner, subtle teal-tinted backgrounds

electric-magenta.$description: Electric Magenta — Secondary accent — beta badges, inline code highlights, experimental product card, code snippet button

plum-edge.$description: Plum Edge — Chromatic card border for the open-source / self-hosted product variant

inter.$description: Single typeface across the entire system. Weight 800 at 72px for hero headlines, weight 600-700 for product card titles and section headings, weight 500 for nav and labels, weight 400 for body and descriptions. Consistent -0.025em tracking tightens the geometric forms and gives the dark UI a compressed, technical feel.
